data.title: Michael Saylor’s Strategy Just Lost Its MSCI Index Spot as Bitcoin Plunges. Is MSTR Stock a Sell?
data.description: With an index provider cutting it loose and bitcoin sitting below its purchase price, Saylor's funding machine faces its toughest test yet. A cash cushion buys time, but one signal could decide whether patience pays off.
